purpose: Validate the pulsation-synchronization engineering of P-04 using a NON-ENZYMATIC membrane. This is a partial validation — full validation requires the biology (items 01-04) to be resolved.

components: Programmable pulsatile pump (0.5-2 Hz, 30-50% amplitude modulation, 0.30 mL/min mean)
Test section with replaceable membrane (non-enzymatic — use dyed cellulose or inert porous polymer)
Flow sensors proximal and distal to membrane (Sensirion SLF3x or equivalent)
Variable orifice valve (Takasago RK-1 or equivalent) for pulsation synchronization
Pressure sensor proximal (Honeywell ABP2 or equivalent)

scenarios.name: no_sync_constant_flow
scenarios.method: Constant Q=0.30 mL/min, valve fully open, no pulsation sync. Measure tau.

scenarios.name: no_sync_pulsatile_flow
scenarios.method: Pulsatile Q mean=0.30, amplitude=40%, freq=1 Hz. Valve fully open. Measure tau.

scenarios.name: sync_pulsatile_flow
scenarios.method: Pulsatile Q mean=0.30, amplitude=40%, freq=1 Hz. Valve synchronized to extend diastolic contact. Measure tau.
scenarios.pass_criterion: tau > 6.0 sec AND total drainage maintained at 0.30 mL/min

scenarios.name: drainage_floor_test
scenarios.method: Induce membrane occlusion (close downstream resistor). Verify fail-safe bypass engages when Q < 0.10 mL/min for >60 sec.
scenarios.pass_criterion: Fail-safe engages within 60 sec of threshold crossing. Drainage restored to >=0.20 mL/min via bypass.

what_this_validates: The pulsation synchronization hypothesis (1.3-1.5x contact time enhancement) and the drainage floor fail-safe mechanism.
what_this_does_NOT_validate: Actual Aβ clearance (requires enzyme), chronic stability (requires months), in vivo safety (requires animal model).
